name: Agents That Deploy Infrastructure
tagline: Agents that take software from an idea to something running in production - provisioning, deploying, configuring and operating the stack

charter.focus: agents taking software from an idea to production and operating the stack
charter.mission: Ensure advanced AI is governed as a public good, with benefits shared widely and deployed toward humanity's most urgent challenges.

zones.name: Idea Bench
zones.purpose: Where an idea is turned into a plan of what to build and run
zones.source: worlds/sources/founder-tracks-2026-09-28.md, Agents That Deploy Infrastructure: 'from an idea'

zones.name: Provisioning Yard
zones.purpose: Provisioning infrastructure: compute, storage and networks, as rehearsed plans

zones.name: Deployment Bay
zones.purpose: Deploying applications: builds, releases and rollbacks

zones.name: Service Configuration Room
zones.purpose: Configuring services: settings, secrets handling policy and wiring

zones.name: Operations Deck
zones.purpose: Operating the stack: health, logs, incidents and the on-call handoff to people
zones.source: worlds/sources/founder-tracks-2026-09-28.md, Agents That Deploy Infrastructure: 'operating the stack'

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Turns an idea into a build-and-run plan the stewards can read
agents.source: worlds/sources/founder-tracks-2026-09-28.md, Agents That Deploy Infrastructure: 'from an idea to something running in production'

agents.name: Provisioner
agents.role: Provisions infrastructure from the plan, in rehearsal until a steward approves

agents.name: Deployer
agents.role: Deploys applications and keeps a rollback ready

agents.name: Domain Steward
agents.role: Manages domains and records; registrations are a steward decision

agents.name: Configurator
agents.role: Configures services; never holds a live secret in a prompt

agents.name: Operator
agents.role: Operates the stack and hands incidents to people
agents.source: worlds/sources/founder-tracks-2026-09-28.md, Agents That Deploy Infrastructure: 'operating the stack'

gaps: No cloud, provider, domain, registrar or stack is named; nothing is deployed from this world
Spending on infrastructure is treasury.transfer, reserved for human stewards
